daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo addressed the influential role of Nahdlatul Ulama at its national congress, joking about TNI and Police chiefs wearing NU kopiah while hailing the organisation's influence in Indonesian politics. The president also announced plans to target 800 underperforming SOEs for closure as part of restructuring state enterprises. The Constitutional Court struck several student petitioners from proceedings after they failed to attend hearings, with justices questioning the seriousness of their applications.

  • A controversy erupted after the chairman of a student council received Rp 20 million after a demonstration, prompting the palace to investigate the payment and PDI-P to call it orchestration from above.
  • The court will deliver Nadiem's graft verdict on June 30 following his corruption trial.
  • Minister Yusril stated that Ombudsman can supervise Koperasi Merah Putih as part of governance oversight mechanisms.
  • The KPK transferred case files of three former customs officials to the anti-corruption court.
  • A DPR deputy urged police to immediately arrest the Bandung kidnapping perpetrator, while fellow lawmakers called for strengthened protection for women following the case.
  • The KPK is investigating special additional hajj quota allocations at Maktour Travel amid corruption concerns.
  • A model allegedly involved in a DPR bribery case again failed to attend KPK summons regarding Rp 2 billion in alleged payments.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Deputy Foreign Minister Anis Matta pushed for strengthened partnership with Bulgaria during bilateral discussions. Indonesia's national charity agency Baznas deepened its Palestine aid partnership with a Turkish NGO to coordinate humanitarian assistance.

  • Indonesia and Russia agreed to optimise national currencies in bilateral trade to reduce dollar dependence.
  • The ASEAN Secretary-General supported energy collaboration with Canada in regional development initiatives.

Other

Investigators uncovered 100 fictitious MBG kitchens in Cilacap located in forests and graveyards, raising major questions about the free nutritious meals programme. The Deputy Industry Minister emphasised that improving MBG's governance is crucial to programme success. Parents reported that after MBG was temporarily halted, staple food prices declined.

  • The Health Minister noted anti-vaccine groups are increasing and unveiled a new education strategy to counter vaccine hesitancy, while the government merged free health checks and school vaccinations for 2026.
  • Indonesia partnered with The Lancet to shape its long-term medical strategy through academic collaboration.
  • The Ministry announced AI regulation aims to boost productive use of technology in Indonesia's digital economy.
  • Indonesia launched DEAL 2026 to accelerate digital transformation across government and business sectors.
  • The government is pushing downstreaming of 10 social forestry commodities to add value domestically before export.
